response.text:
Here are the deadlines coming up in October:

- **Return overdue library books** to Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt [party:pty_d2ymm5s3htd0] — due **Fri 2 Oct 2026** [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Fees rise the longer it's overdue, and your account can be blocked once fees reach a cap.

- **Mobile contract cancellation** (FunkNetz Smart M) [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2] with FunkNetz Mobil GmbH [party:pty_gjsv4q2d3ajw] — must arrive by **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, so post by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. Current term ends **Sat 14 Nov 2026** [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].

- **Decide on objecting to a contribution notice** from Muster BKK [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3] — due **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, so send by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. Note: contributions must still be paid at the assessed amount even if you object, since an objection has no suspensive effect.

- **Energy contract (MusterStrom Flex) special cancellation** [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5] with Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH [party:pty_fh8cf155ffm3] — a price increase takes effect **Sun 1 Nov 2026**; cancel without notice so it arrives by **Sat 31 Oct 2026** (safe to send by **Fri 30 Oct 2026**, send_by shown as **Mon 26 Oct 2026**) [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5]. Cancelling by then avoids the new price.

You can draft cancellation letters or mark the library return/objection done directly in Ordnung.
